dedupe_keys.name: apec energy database egeda energy balances electricity generation and capacity quarterly and monthly supply for 21 apec economies

description: The APEC Energy Database, run by the APEC Expert Group on Energy Data and Analysis (EGEDA) with the energy statistics office of the Asia Pacific Energy Research Centre (APERC), is a consolidated repository of official energy data submitted by all 21 APEC member economies, from Australia to Viet Nam. Annual data cover coal, oil, natural gas, new and renewable energy, electricity and heat from production through trade and transformation to final consumption and international bunkers, presented as energy balance tables in a new format that separates non-energy use; separate tables give electricity power generation, electricity generating capacity (from 1980, by economy and plant type such as thermal), primary energy supply, final energy consumption and demand and supply by energy source. Quarterly supply data for coal, oil, natural gas and electricity are collected four months after each quarter, monthly oil and gas data come through JODI questionnaires, and CO2 emissions are submitted by economies. The 2023 annual balances were uploaded in 2026. Coverage: the 21 APEC economies. Format and access: web query forms that return tables by economy, product and year; free, except a members-only section (energy prices, economic data) behind a password. Licence: not read; pages carry an APERC copyright line. Caveats: download formats of the query results were not checked. Simulation uses: national electricity capacity, generation and fuel supply series for energy system and supply security scenarios across Asia and the Pacific. Related records: the JODI-Oil (data-jodi-oil-world-database) and JODI-Gas (data-jodi-gas-world-database) databases supply the monthly data.
